_doc: THE LAST LIGHT campaign (layout 3: Stage 3B plus the brief of 2026-11-06, ch1 dark arrival; STAGE3_NARRATIVE_MASTER.md §7, §20b). Beats run in order; 'when' is a StoryState expression (flag(), has_flag(), clue(), saved(), lost(), piloting(), lit_by_hand(), relation(), sim.*). 'hint' is [seconds, text(, unless <expr>)] or a list of them (item 36: a hint whose 'unless' is already true is skipped). 'objective' is a string or {title, steps: [{text, done <expr>, live}]} (item 9). Director actions: talk, wait, until <expr>, release <ship> (a holding story ship makes way), objective, set/unset/add/clue, ship, storm, clock, fault (jam [story] | trip | overheat), battery, mode, intensity, autosave, timeskip, ending_card, end_campaign; presentation events for game_fp: hint, sky, phantom_echo, footsteps, knock, door_open, visitor_enter, sfx, static, music, caption. story_test rejects unknown names. 'optional_calls' are radio calls offered in the panel after beat open_after has run and until beat close_at has run; 'needs_power' (brief item 32) marks a beat that can only move on with power (radio or light): while it waits unpowered the director shows what to fix. 'story_voice' lists ships whose 'we have the channel lights' report a story conversation speaks itself (item 26). 'after_read' maps a document to [first chapter, last chapter, conversation] room lines played once each.

steps.text: Find the torch: top storage shelf, by the stair door
Open the generator's FUEL VALVE (the cage, south-west)
Hold START until the engine catches
Switch CHARGE on at the charger (west wall)
The lights come on

hint: It's dark. The torch is on the top storage shelf by the stair door: look at it and press {interact}.
has_flag("torch_taken")
Move with {move}. Look around with {look}.
has_flag("moved")
In the cage: the red FUEL VALVE handle first, then hold {interact} on the black START button until the engine catches.
The CHARGE lever is on the charger cabinet, below the small meter.

steps.text: At the light console (under the east window): MODE to AUTO
LAMP to NORMAL

hint: The light console stands under the east window. Look at the MODE knob and press {interact}.
Sit at the radio on the desk (look at it, press {interact}), select Kittiwake and choose Confirm position.

steps.text: At the radio (desk), select Kittiwake and choose CONFIRM POSITION
Wait for her position report
Turn her onto the North Sound leading line: due north, 000° (the dashed line on the radar)

hint: On the radar she sits to the right of the dashed 000° line. Order TURN PORT (her left) once or twice, then MAINTAIN when she points down the line. The chart's transcription ({transcript}) explains the terms.

steps.text: Open the station log on the desk

hint: The logbook lies open on the desk, left of the chart.

beats.objective: Watch the radar for the caller

steps.text: Turn her onto the West Gut line: 314°, north-west
See her in to shelter

hint: Confirm Gannet's position, then turn her until she points down the West Gut line on the radar.

steps.text: The old-log box: top storage shelf, left of the stair door

hint: The old station logs are in the oak box on the top storage shelf, left of the stair door.

objective.title: Free the jammed gear by hand

steps.text: MODE to OFF (the motor off)
Turn the handwheel back past 046°
MODE back to AUTO

hint: At the light console: {turn_back} on the MODE knob turns it back to OFF. With the motor off, {wheel} on the handwheel turns the optic by hand. Then MODE to AUTO.

optional_calls.label: Call Gannet (Hector, in the West Gut lee)

objective.title: Bring both boats in (mind the battery)

steps.text: Corrie May: into the East Gut, 046° (north-east)
Lowestoft Star: into the North Sound, 000° (due north)

beats.when: (saved("Corrie May") or lost("Corrie May")) and (saved("Lowestoft Star") or lost("Lowestoft Star"))
hint: Corrie May belongs in the East Gut (046°), Lowestoft Star in the North Sound (000°). Confirm each, then turn them onto the lines.

steps.text: Reset the MAIN breaker (tall cabinet, west wall)

hint: In the dark: the red MAIN lamp on the tall cabinet. Push the MAIN lever up ({interact}).

optional_calls.label: Call Stornoway on the MF set (2182 kHz)

steps.text: MODE to MANUAL
Hold the beam on her with the handwheel

hint: MODE to MANUAL, then at the console hold {wheel} on the handwheel until the beam sits on her (the radar shows the beam line).

beats.objective: She will not answer. Watch her come in.

do: [A cough, deep in the chest. It goes on a long time.]
[Footsteps on the stair. One step at a time.]

hint: The stair door is on the south wall.
The bottom-left drawer of the desk.

steps.text: Reset the MAIN breaker
Get the generator running (if it cut out hot, let it cool first)

hint: MAIN breaker on the west wall. If the generator has cut out hot, let it cool, then restart it.

objective.title: Free the jammed gear by hand

steps.text: MODE to OFF (the motor off)
Back the handwheel past 046°
MODE to MANUAL

hint: At the light console: {turn_back} on the MODE knob to OFF, {wheel} on the handwheel to back the optic off the tooth, then MODE to MANUAL.

objective.title: Bring Iona Star through the East Gut

steps.text: Hold the light on her in MANUAL
Turn her onto the East Gut line: 046°, north-east

hint: MANUAL mode puts a long beam on her so she can see. Confirm her position, then turn her onto the 046° line.
